dog.description_text: Meet LadyBug — New Arrival! LadyBug just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FLadyBug%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQqxDREFFTdbTLYQc%2DL%2D2dFMEgUCypmWFYQT1PGOGLuSjVuisg Her foster says "She is cuddly and loving. Happy to sit and be calm but loves to play with the stuffy and go on walks. I haven't heard any barking or crying from her at all. She seems very interested in meeting dogs. She loves meeting new people and is warm to everyone who wants to greet her. Ladybug is potty and crate trained. Ladybug is a 1 and a half year old mixed breed dog. She is vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
